sentences.en: She always destroys my mood with her caustic remarks.
sentences.zh: 她总是用挖苦的话破坏我的心情。

sentences.en: I ask you to spare me your caustic remarks.
sentences.zh: 我求你别再对我说那些讽刺的话了。

sentences.en: Though common in cleaning products, ammonia is caustic.
sentences.zh: 虽然氨在清洁产品中很常见，但它具有腐蚀性。

senses.zh: 腐蚀性的；苛性的；刻薄的
